text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 灰色翻边罗纹针织帽。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One standalone photorealistic wardrobe catalogue product photo. Pure white seamless background, neutral soft studio lighting, realistic fabric texture. Portrait 2:3, full objects uncropped with comfortable margins. NO people, skin, body parts, face, hair, visible mannequin, hangers, stand, scene, text, brand logos or watermark. Hollow invisible-mannequin presentation; see white background through sheer fabrics. Preserve the reference garment colors, silhouette, construction and fabric. Do not invent footwear when not visible. Reconstruct obscured seams conservatively. Reference image is design input only. Target ONLY image 2 position left. rNcM means row N, column M, counted left to right, top to bottom across the full image. Images 3 through 7 each have exactly two rows and four columns. Images 2 and 8 through 15 have two people side by side. Image 1 is a single outfit with accessories. Ignore all other outfits, text and objects. Show ONLY this one detachable accessory: 灰色翻边罗纹针织帽. Match its reference design, show whole chains and straps. A matching pair of earrings or gloves or explicitly named jewelry ensemble counts as one item. Small obscured jewelry details must be conservatively interpreted, not elaborate. Props such as coffee or books remain a styling accessory for this outfit. No clothing, footwear, other accessories or collage.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
